verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are positioned as isolated environments where autonomous agents can run with tools and credentials in place (modal-docs-3, modal-docs-19). An agent example executes LLM-generated code in a Sandbox (modal-docs-22, modal-docs-30), and logs can be fetched or tailed to monitor background runs (modal-docs-23). A community user built self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on Sandboxes (modal-comm-1). However, Sandboxes are an execution substrate: the user must write code to orchestrate the automation, and the pack shows no scheduling, triggers, or built-in automation setup. missing for 10: documented scheduling/cron or event triggers for sandbox runs, a first-party way to define and manage recurring background automations, independent hands-on evidence of long-running unattended automations.
